gap.context: SKETCH: No proof is expected here in one piece: propose a cut into smaller statements. A least circuit has no removable gate, so padding plays no part. Known by computation: on the small bipartite graphs with no 4-cycle an exhaustive search at least size finds no top-stuck circuit that is not two-level; one gate above least size they exist (the AND of the three prime clauses of the path on four vertices is the smallest). The open part is sharing between products: a wire read by two blocks and needed by both; No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

gap.title: 4-cycle-free bipartite incidence: every least exact fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for it that is top-stuck is two-level
gap.unlocks: With the checked normal form of the lift, this gives: on a bipartite graph with no 4-cycle some least circuit is two-level, which with a checked count is the one-output bound.
